title: Delivery timeline uses wrong API paths, so tracking never loads or saves
expected: Buyer sees delivery updates; seller can add one. Backend contract: GET /api/delivery/order/:orderId and POST /api/delivery.
actual: Frontend calls GET /api/delivery/:orderId (404, error swallowed by .catch(() => {}) so the list looks empty) and POST /api/delivery/:orderId (404, 'Failed to add delivery update').
impact: delivery_tracking is enabled for 100% of users but cannot work; buyers see no updates and sellers cannot post any.
fix: Use GET /api/delivery/order/${orderId} and POST /api/delivery with order_id in the body (match backend validation). Show an error state instead of an empty list when loading fails.
